name: ENAMEL AND PEARL PENDANT, circa 1902–1903
note: A pendant in 18k gold with blue guilloche enamel frame, a carved and stained simulated ivory plaque of five dancing nymphs, and a drop-shaped pearl. Dated circa 1902–1903 by the auction house.
credit: Christie's, lot 391 (sale probably "Magnificent Jewels", not confirmed on the page)
